text: Have been waiting a while so I'll just put it here. Stepson, 8, temp 38.6. Sore throat but he's drinking fine. Honestly he seems ok when the ibuprofen kicks in, running about, chatty, eating crisps. Breathing's normal as far as I can tell. His cheeks are bright red but I think that's just from being out in that cold wind at the park earlier, they always go like that and they're already fading now he's warmed up. Not sure if I even need to be asking, his dad just wanted me to check
